categories.label: Story Element
categories.purpose: Low-friction narrative, foreshadowing, lore pressure, room flavor, or run pacing.
content_rules: Usually one proceed-style outcome.
May hint at future danger but should not promise unsupported delayed mechanics.
Use when the event should shape tone more than stats.

categories.label: Narrative Beat
categories.purpose: Low-friction pacing, room texture, warning, or clone-memory narration.
content_rules: Usually one proceed-style outcome.
Should still foreshadow pressure, loss, pursuit, or route change.
Prefer short field-report phrasing over exposition.

categories.label: Scenario Choice
categories.purpose: A compact story dilemma with two or three readable actions and implicit future pressure.
content_rules: Use when no more specific category fits.
Each button should imply a distinct pressure, branch, or identity shift without spelling out the full risk tree.
Prefer existing actions unless the patch explicitly proposes engine changes.

categories.label: Shop
categories.purpose: Merchant, barter, purchase, sacrifice-for-resource, or offer/browse moments.
content_rules: Current shop support is mostly placeholder.
Use required_engine_changes for real buying, inventory, pricing, or wares.
Avoid adding browse_wares unless engine support is implemented.

categories.label: Merchant
categories.purpose: Merchant arrival, barter, refusal, debt, purchase pressure, or merchant reckoning.
content_rules: The exchange is pressure, not a rest stop.
Purchases should imply corruption, debt, or future leverage.
Refusal should be remembered when repeated.

categories.label: Symbiote
categories.purpose: Bonding with, refusing, damaging, or discovering a symbiotic organism.
content_rules: Include symbiote_id when using take_symbiote.
Use an existing symbiote unless the patch also proposes a new symbiote entry.
The text should make bodily permanence or dependency clear.

categories.label: Mutation
categories.purpose: Taking, refusing, or being tempted by a mutation.
content_rules: Include mutation_id when using take_mutation.
Use an existing mutation unless the patch also proposes a new mutation entry.
State the physical bargain plainly, but keep future branch pressure implicit.

categories.label: Combat
categories.purpose: Enemy encounter, ambush, or fight-as-choice scenario.
content_rules: Include enemy_id when using combat.
Use an existing enemy unless the patch also proposes a new enemy entry.
The non-combat option should still have a cost or loss of opportunity.

categories.label: Healing
categories.purpose: Recovery, clean/unclean medicine, shield restoration, or healing temptation.
content_rules: Healing should usually involve corruption, danger, or uncertainty.
Use drink_pool and study_pool when possible.
Avoid free recovery without a tonal or mechanical cost.

categories.label: Amber Resource
categories.purpose: Amber sacs, resin, shield recovery, sealed wounds, or pressurized salvage.
content_rules: Amber should feel pressurized, useful, and not fully clean.
Resource gain should carry damage, corruption, attention, or lost safety.
Shield recovery should still leave residue or tactical cost.

categories.label: Resource
categories.purpose: Biomass, harvest, salvage, amber, marrow, or body-material gain.
content_rules: Make the material gain concrete.
Make the immediate physical pressure visible without labeling the future risk tree.
Use room-appropriate verbs: cut, siphon, harvest, cauterize, seal.

categories.label: Hazard
categories.purpose: Damage, pressure, spikes, contamination, danger rise, or forced passage.
content_rules: The hazard should be readable before the choice.
Use existing damage actions when possible.
Use required_engine_changes for delayed or room-count consequences.

categories.label: Danger Notice
categories.purpose: A warning that the organism has noticed Hymn and is increasing pursuit pressure.
content_rules: Danger is attention, not a generic difficulty popup.
Use as a warning before pursuit, ambush, or hunter pressure escalates.
Text should make the environment feel like it learned something.

categories.label: Corruption Pressure
categories.purpose: A threshold warning, body drift, corruption spike, or forced cost from invasive power.
content_rules: Corruption should feel useful first and identity-threatening later.
Use as warning or pressure when the player repeats body-altering choices.
Avoid abstract moral language; show physical drift.

categories.label: Boss Encounter
categories.purpose: Major enemy, chamber guardian, forced reckoning, or floor-defining fight.
content_rules: Boss events should establish what system function the enemy protects.
Bypass choices should cost access, information, danger, or ending pressure.
Use sparingly as a run-shaping event.

categories.label: Transition
categories.purpose: Floor changes, pacing breaks, preview rooms, run-state changes, or threshold moments.
content_rules: Use sparingly.
Should orient the player toward a coming change.
Do not change deck rules unless required_engine_changes describes the implementation.
